teHi Margarita,
currently, the activityOverlap function is rather limited in its flexibility and provides a standard heading which can't be removed. 
Also the legend cannot be modified freely. 
For now I'd say use the overlapPlot function of the overlap package to customise your plots. 
See this thread for a function to convert date/time (which camtrapR uses) to radial time (used by overlap).

And thank you. I'm glad you find the package useful. 
Best,
Jürgen
